changes.place: upper pencil drawing: sole vertex and loops
changes.h: une boucle attachée à un sommet
changes.evidence: Four pencil runs leave the sole dark vertex. One outline rises leftward and returns diagonally; another rises almost vertically, crosses the first away from the vertex, and returns from the lower right. These are two overlapping closed loops, not C's three-branch outer loop with one interior arc. No additional crossing vertex is marked.

changes.place: top row of miniature point/edge figures
changes.evidence: Three pairs have a visible short joining stroke; the next two pairs have no joining stroke. Ten substantial dark endpoint marks are visible. Nearby tiny isolated specks do not share their size or form and are not graph vertices or labels.

changes.place: six-vertex oval and its internal pencil strokes
changes.evidence: Six dark vertices are certain. The clearest interior strokes run from the upper-left-side vertex toward the lower-right vertex, and from the bottom vertex toward the lower-right vertex; the lower inner arc and perimeter retracings are also visible. Faint upper-to-lower portions disappear beneath the printed hatching. Their visible fragments are retained, with an in-place doubt about their joins, instead of C's completed five-chord graph.

changes.place: long dark two-vertex edge and thin surroundings
changes.h: deux arêtes à deux sommets, chaque sommet entouré de petits cercles et l'arête entourée de courbes ovales
changes.evidence: The dark edge has two marked endpoints, thin continuations beyond both ends, endpoint enclosures, a long surrounding contour, and two thin rays at the right endpoint. The surrounding outline and right endpoint enclosure have pen gaps. The paths are traced with those gaps; C's forced closed surrounding contour and exact circles conceal them. H does not record the extensions or rays.

changes.place: short dark/retraced two-vertex edge in a broad enclosure
changes.h: deux arêtes à deux sommets, chaque sommet entouré de petits cercles et l'arête entourée de courbes ovales
changes.evidence: Two dark endpoint marks have small thin enclosures. Two closely spaced traced runs make the joining edge, with a narrow pale interval between them in the middle. The broad surrounding curve has a visible upper pen gap and the left endpoint enclosure has a small gap; these are not replaced by exact closed ellipses.

changes.place: two-hole oval with connecting and radial strokes
changes.h: un disque à deux trous reliés par une bande, avec des segments radiaux.
changes.evidence: The two inner closed outlines, the outer oval with its upper pen gap, two principal connecting strokes, and the source-visible radial runs are reproduced. Additional faint connecting/upper radial fragments and the upper-left run from the lower hole cannot all be joined securely through the hatching. They remain visibly doubtful; no missing run is supplied by symmetry and the ten evenly regular spokes in C are not imposed.

changes.place: six repeated job-record lines, read with listing upright

All have four initial asterisks, A, END JOB 653, PREDONTA, ROOM, 11.24.04 AM 02 JUN 82, R6.PR1, SYS JES2 JOB 653 END, A and four final asterisks.
